notes.title: Free DLC released
notes.content:
Desktop Hacker - Echoes of Pandora brings you into the intriguing era of early 2000s hacking. In this expansion, uncover a hidden digital conspiracy using your hacking skills and the mysterious Pandora hack. Each step takes you deeper into a captivating story set in the world of cyber espionage.

DLC is free and now available for download.

notes.title: Minor patch for chat and console clearing bug
notes.content: Patched a text box overflow for chat and console windows that would cause those windows to stop displaying data.

notes.title: Release date set
notes.content:
Dear hacking game fans,

I am thrilled to announce that my indie game, Desktop Hacker, will be released on Steam at the end of April!

In this game, you will have the opportunity to become a hacker, using your skills to break into computer systems and complete missions.

I have put a lot of hard work and dedication into creating this game, and I cannot wait for you to experience it for yourself. I hope that you will enjoy the gameplay and captivating storyline that Desktop Hacker has to offer.

If you want to stay up-to-date with the latest news and updates about the game, please join us on our Discord server! There you can connect with other fans, ask questions, and get the inside scoop on what's coming next.

[url=https://discord.gg/pCUY4nXzM4]https://discord.gg/pCUY4nXzM4[/url]

notes.title: Development is complete
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I am thrilled to announce that development on Desktop Hacker, my passion project, is officially complete! It has been an incredible journey creating this game as a solo indie developer.

I poured my heart and soul into this game, crafting a thrilling narrative-driven hacking experience that I hope will immerse players in a world of intrigue and cybercrime.

But before we can release Desktop Hacker to the world, I want to ensure that it is the best possible experience for all players. That's why I'll be conducting a playtest soon to gather feedback and make any necessary tweaks and adjustments.

Once the playtest is complete, I will set a release date for Desktop Hacker. I can't wait for everyone to finally get their hands on this game and experience the thrill of hacking their way through an intricate storyline.

Thank you for your support throughout the development process. I'm excited to share Desktop Hacker with you soon!
